instruction: Go to the community discussions section and click on the topic that has accumulated the most replies.

metadata.explanation: Task directs user to navigate to discussions and open the most-replied topic. Evaluator verifies successful navigation to the correct discussion URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_active_tab_info getter to extract active tab URL state
Metric is_expected_active_tab properly compares actual vs expected URL using compare_urls function
Logic flow is sound: accessibility tree -> get active URL -> navigate with Playwright -> compare URL
Minor semantic gap: evaluator verifies navigation to specific URL but cannot verify user correctly identified 'most replied' topic
Time-sensitivity concern: hardcoded expected URL assumes 'most replied' topic never changes on live website
Acceptable given snapshot-based evaluation environment where website state is frozen
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding metadata verification that confirms the expected URL actually has the most replies at evaluation time
Alternative approach: use get_info_from_website to extract reply counts and verify the opened topic has maximum replies
